verdict.rationale: New Relic is a SaaS observability platform, so whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack never documents an open-source license for the platform or its agents. The only GitHub items describe features of the newrelic-cli repository and say nothing about its license. Community comments raise open-source client libraries only as a Datadog advantage, which does not show New Relic offers them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
